scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: Sports day! Green team against blue team — and Luna is the official ball-fetcher!
scene.intro: Sports day! Green team against blue team, and Luna is the loudest supporter of both. Sofía runs fast, very fast, and she jumps high in the long jump. Mateo throws the ball well but catches it badly, so his team laughs and then wins anyway. Everybody runs, everybody claps. Who runs fastest in YOUR class? Come to the race and cheer!

data.voice_note: Voces: Mateo (comentarista) y Sofía (estrella del día).
data.script: Mateo: Sports day, live! First race: one hundred metres. … Mateo: Sofia runs like the wind… and wins! Green team, five points. … Mateo: Now the high jump. Erik jumps… one metre ten! … Mateo: The ball race: Valentina throws, I catch… oops, I dropped it. Blue team laughs. … Mateo: But Luna catches the next one IN THE AIR. The crowd goes crazy! … Mateo: Final score: green twenty, blue eighteen. … Sofia: And everyone gets ice cream, because on sports day everybody wins something!

data.title: I'm good at running!
data.intro: What can you do well? Say good at and then the sport — or the verb with -ing.
data.can: I can say what I am good at, and ask my friends what they are good at.

examples.text: Mateo is good at running. He is always the winner.
I'm not very good at throwing, but I can catch!

rules: am / is / are + good at + a sport, or a verb with -ing.
For the negative: is not very good at… It sounds kinder.

items.sentence: ___ you good at catching the ball?
